chunks: And from him, from Abd al-Rahman, from Abd Allah ibn Sinan, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): I found lice or a scab upon myself which I remove. He said: 'Yes, and their young ones, for they have ascended in a place where they did not descend.'

key_terms.حَلَمَةً: A scab or crust on the skin

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on removing lice or scabs while in Ihram according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that removing adult lice or scabs while in Ihram requires also removing their young, as the adults descended to the body to lay eggs, necessitating the removal of the young from the same place to complete the act of purification. This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on thoroughness in fulfilling ritual obligations, ensuring that the intent of purification is not compromised by leaving behind the source of the impurity. The hadith underscores the importance of understanding the biological context behind ritual laws to ensure their proper application.
